name: Azure OpenAI Augmentor
description: Provides Augmentor integration with the Azure OpenAI API.
project_description: The Azure OpenAI Augmentor is a plugin provider for the Augmentor framework that connects a Drupal site to the Azure OpenAI API. It ships two Augmentor plugins — Azure OpenAI Chat (azure_openai_chat) and Azure OpenAI Completions (azure_openai_completions) — built on the openai-php/client library. Each plugin is configured through Augmentor's own admin UI (webservices > augmentors), where you supply a Key-module API key, an Azure resource/deployment base URL, an API version, and a prompt template. It has no routes, permissions, config schema, or services of its own; all of that is inherited from the augmentor base module. Requires the Augmentor module.
